cross_database_conflicts.source_context: SI methods text reads SC5341 and Table S1 lacks strain detail.
Local current-paper source does not contain these extra targets/values.
Main text supports <7.1% cell viability loss at 80 µM; database reports 10/15% killing.
Database says five clinical isolates; SI supports four C1/C2/C3/C5 isolates for the range.

quality_cautions: Merged database sequence rows omit terminal amide/disulfide annotation; primary source supports modifications.
No APD6 or DRAMP rows are present for this DOI.
